{{Quote|I know that treachery can break even the mightiest foe. And for those who study its secrets, the Force offers&hellip; unlimited power.|[[Darth Nox|Kallig]], a Sith Inquisitor|<ref name="TORYouTube">{{TORYouTube|wdhQPA5tOzA|STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Classes - The Sith Inquisitor|date=2011-05-13}}</ref>}}
'''Sith Inquisitors''' were a class of powerful Force-wielders within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], operating primarily within the upper echelons and political circles. In contrast to their counterparts, the [[Sith Warrior]]s, Inquisitors specialized in Force abilities as opposed to martial might, and many would devote much time to researching new skills to survive in the cutthroat Sith political environment. Few acolytes succeeded in becoming Inquisitors. However, those who did succeed proved to be some of the most cunning and devoted Sith in the order.

On the battlefield, Inquisitors were a spectacle to behold, channeling vast amounts of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side Force]] energy to create massive storms of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], or draining the life force of enemies to feed themselves and their allies. However, most Inquisitors preferred a more manipulative operating style, being masters of exploiting both enemies and allies to further their own agendas.

==Overview==
{{Quote|The true power of the dark side; it is claimed by many, but known by few.|[[Darth Nox]]|<ref name="TORYouTube" />}}
[[File:Sith_Inquisitor_TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Sith Inquisitor wielding a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].]]
Sith Inquisitors operated in the political circle and upper echelons of Sith society, relying on their natural cunning and ambitious drive to succeed. The Inquisitor experimented with forbidden powers to not only survive in the cutthroat environment, but to excel and seize authority. The most formidable Inquisitors dared to explore unorthodox practices by investigating the enigmas of the past and by unlocking new powers for themselves. Due to their manipulative genius, Inquisitors were skilled at exploiting both their enemies and their allies to further their own personal agendas.<ref name="SwTorWebSite">{{Holonet|classes|sith-inquisitor|Sith Inquisitor}}</ref>

Regardless of potential, few acolytes succeeded in facing the rigorous trials to become Sith Inquisitors. Only the most determined acolytes attained such an achievement, but these Sith were often the ones to watch. Though their skills were varied and many, Sith Inquisitors were most feared for their ability to channel the energy of the Force, making them a spectacle to behold on the battlefield. Channeling this Force energy, Inquisitors were capable of draining the life from their enemies and using it to feed themselves and their allies, and those who have experienced the sensation of the Inquisitor's Force lightning and survived forever recoil from the crackling sound of electricity.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />

===Weapons and apparel===
{{Main|Sith apparel}}
[[File:Sith_Doublesabers.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A collection of Sith Doublesabers.]]
The clothing choices of Sith Inquisitors were often very calculated, with their elaborate robes designed to both illustrate their sophisticated tastes and desire for political domination, but also being practical and flexible to facilitate their stunning acrobatic movements in combat. Some Inquisitors had been known to take this desire for personal expression to the absolute limit, favoring attire designed to inspire sheer terror in those they come into contact with.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />
Sith Inquisitors often favored [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]], or saberstaffs, in combat. In addition to wielding such an unorthodox weapon, Sith Inquisitors often utilized much more esoteric and customized models of such armament, especially in contrast to the more technical and pragmatic weapons favored by [[Sith Warrior]]s, featuring such details as exposed [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal chambers]] or artificially-generated Force lightning running through the hilt.<ref name="DesigningTheDarkSide">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/designing-dark-side|text=Video - Designing the Dark Side}}</ref>

===Combat tactics===
[[File:Korriban_duel_now_with_lightning.png|thumb|left|200px|The Inquisitor [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] applies Force lightning in combat.]]
Expertise in conducting Force energies further allows Inquisitors to [[Force drain/Legends|draw upon]] the life essence of themselves and others. This energy could be channeled to bolster their powers, harm their foes, and even to reinvigorate their allies. Inquisitors fought with unlimited fury to create a storm of destruction. An Inquisitor's skills with a lightsaber were equally impressive. Often wielding a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], Inquisitors used quick, guileful, and lethal maneuvers to strike their enemies down with astonishing speed. Whether the Inquisitor wielded a lightsaber with lightning-sharp attacks, or just [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] itself, it was always a dazzling display of deadly energy.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />

==Specializations==
===Sith sorcerer===
{{Main|Sith sorcerer}}
The specialization of Sorcerer offered the greatest level of raw Force ability, as these adepts drew their power from the darkest corners of the Force, unleashing volatile energies that could wreak utter devastation against enemies. In addition to this, Sorcerers were capable of healing and bolstering their allies with these same abilities. With the very air around them crackling with energy, powerful Sorcerers had a reputation for torturous retaliations against those foolish enough to get in their way.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />

===Sith assassin===
{{Main|Sith assassin/Legends}}
Whereas Sorcerers focused on raw power, Sith Assassins preferred a subtler approach. Speed and deception were their tools of the trade, relying on stealth tactics to infiltrate enemy ranks and remove high-profile targets. Even in open battle, Assassins were utterly deadly, relying on both tactical awareness and [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]] to assault enemies both physically and mentally, manipulating a confrontation to ensure their side maintains the upper hand. While highly skilled with the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaff]], their weapon of choice for both offense and defense, Assassins could channel the Force just as easily.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />

==History==
[[File:Naga_Sadow_WotC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Naga Sadow, a powerful Sith Sorcerer and Dark Lord.]]
Sith adepts who specialized in [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] were prevalent within their organizations and empires since the beginning, with notables such as [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] bearing the moniker of [[Sith sorcerer]].<ref name="TOTJFirstEncounter">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> After the defeat of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] reorganized such specialists into the Sith Inquisitor class, with the term "sorcerer" coming to refer to a specialization class within their ranks.<ref name="SwTorWebSite" />

However, while the new Empire established and rebuilt itself, Sith sorcerers with no affiliation to nor knowledge of them cropped up and terrorized various corners of the galaxy. Examples including [[Freedon Nadd]] and certain members of both the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] and the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan monarchies]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> However, the most notable such practitioner was [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was trained in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] by [[Freedon Nadd]] and dubbed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] by a gathering of [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirits]] led by [[Marka Ragnos]].<ref name="DLOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> Kun united the various other Sith practitioners and started the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] against the Republic, ravaging the galaxy and notably destroying the Jedi training world, Ossus, before being defeated.<ref name="TGSW">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref>

When the Sith Empire returned and attacked the Republic, a notable Inquisitor involved in the [[Battle of Korriban|initial engagement]] was [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Vindican and his apprentice, the [[Sith Warrior]] [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], led the assault on a Republic space station above Korriban, and crossed blades with Jedi [[Kao Cen Darach]] and [[Satele Shan]], the first Sith to do so for centuries. Shan fled the battle, leaving Malgus and Vindican to contend with Darach. Wielding [[Jar'Kai/Legends|dual-lightsabers]], Darach fended off the two Sith and subdued Vindican by impaling him. Malgus took up his master's lightsaber and killed Darach, before executing his master and assuming his mantle as Sith Lord.<ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], another prominent Inquisitor was [[Darth Chratis]],<ref name="ChratisInq">Darth Chratis was never explicitly identified as a Sith Inquisitor; however, his physical appearance, Force abilities, and style of lightsaber all correspond to the features of the Sith Inquisitor class as presented in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It should be noted that all the characters presented in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' represent members of the different classes available to players in ''The Old Republic'' game.</ref> who was involved in the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|joint Republic/Sith assault on Sebaddon]], to halt the destructive actions of the uncontrollable [[Fastbreeder|Hex droids]]. Chratis was overwhelmed by the machines after [[Eldon Ax|his apprentice]] gained control of them and turned on him.<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>

After the disappearance of the Sith Empire, the term "Inquisitor" largely faded from practice, with most substituting the older title of "Sorcerer". When the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] was enacted by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the terms "Inquisitor" or "Sorcerer" came to refer more to individual specializations rather than an overall class system, as there were only two Sith Lords at any one time.<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> A notable Sorcerer under the Rule of Two was Bane's apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]].<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> When [[Darth Krayt]] abolished the Rule of Two and established his [[One Sith]] organization, he reformed the Inquisitors, with a notable member being the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Darth Havok]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Inquisitor is a [[Darth Nox|playable class]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It is one of two [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user classes aligned with the Sith Empire, along with the [[Sith Warrior]]. The class focuses on ranged Force powers such as Force lightning. The characters of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] are cited as inspirations for this class.<ref name="gamespot">{{GameSpot|url=pc/rpg/starwarstheoldrepublic/news.html?sid=6241909&mode=previews|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic Hands-On - The Sith Inquisitor}}</ref> The advanced classes for the Sith Inquisitor are the [[Sith sorcerer]] and the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]].
